# Open Source Trello MCP

Trello MCP is an Open Source server that connects Trello with Codex, Loveable and MCP-compatible clients, enabling structured access to boards, lists, and cards for automation and AI workflows.

## A short word about OSS

I love to share my code with others. I look forward to your feedback to consistently improve this repo. It gives me the opportunity to learn more and discuss other approaches.

You can reach out to me by email [andireuter86@gmail.com](mailto:andireuter86@gmail.com?subject=GitHub:%20Trello%20MCP👋).
